q: A topological dynamical system (X, T) is called distal if:
opts: inf_{n≥0} d(Tⁿx, Tⁿy) > 0 for all x ≠ y
Every pair of points is proximal
exp: Distal means no two distinct points are proximal: their orbits never come arbitrarily close. Isometries are distal; the system has rich algebraic structure via the Ellis semigroup.
